evidence: Only packages/web/src/content/docs/permissions.mdx text is edited (2 lines changed) to describe persisted approvals.
codex-rs/core/src/exec_env.rs create_env gains an optional thread-id argument and injects CODEX_THREAD_ID, threaded through shell.rs and user_shell.rs.
One-line change in packages/opencode/src/util/keybind.ts mapping the space key name so the TUI /mcp toggle works.
Only integration-tests/replace.test.ts is changed, marking one integration case as it.skip to remove flake.
New codex-rs/core/src/rollout/error.rs maps io::Error kinds to session-init hints and is wired into codex.rs in place of InternalAgentDied.
Adds a debug toolSearch RPC (app-server protocol types plus tool_search_processor.rs) reusing ToolSearchHandler, with a small session/mod.rs hook.
New packages/gui-extensions/src/ssh/session.ts drives all bootstrap steps over one long-lived ssh process and injects a run() callback into bootstrap(), deleting command.ts.
src/agents/_run_impl.py adds a local_shell_results member to the asyncio.gather tool-execution block and feeds its output back as a tool result.
packages/core/src/config/mcp.ts replaces the numeric timeout with a Timeout schema class (startup/request) and migrate.ts rewrites legacy values.
Only the docs/docs.json Mintlify banner string is updated to the CLI v1.5.1 release.
Only packages/web/src/content/docs/custom-tools.mdx gains a five-line note about tools/ vs tool/.
hosted-monitor-loop.ts sets the ended/settled flags at the early return when the resumed record is already terminal, preventing a second terminal revision.
src/crewai/llm.py adds Gemini-specific _is_gemini_model/_normalize_gemini_model branches and GOOGLE_API_KEY to GEMINI_API_KEY mapping.
loadCliConfig merges the new tools.trusted list into the auto-approved tool set in packages/cli/src/config/config.ts while keeping deprecated tools.allowed.
database_session_service.py append_event() re-reads the session through get_session and changes the stale-time check to strict equality.
llm.py relaxes _matches_provider_pattern for anthropic and adds a provider-pattern fallback loop in _infer_provider_from_model.
chat_agent_executor.py adds a ToolExecutor class and per-tool nodes, changes create_react_agent's signature and routing (+478/-27).
browser_use/browser/profile.py adds an _is_managed_browser_profile PrivateAttr and conditionally appends the mock-keychain flags in get_args().
rmcp_developer.rs interpolates the $SHELL value into the developer extension instruction text sent to the model.
scripts/ingress.mjs and the new scripts/proxy-utils.mjs add a --disable-secure flag that rewrites Set-Cookie headers, covered by __tests__/scripts.
.gemini/config.yaml flips the code_review disable/summary/code_review booleans, which is CI bot automation config, not runtime rules.
.github/workflows/test-suite.yml and e2e-tests.yml add vitest --shard matrix values and shard-suffixed artifact names.
openai-compatible.ts changes updateGlobalRateLimitState to take the attempt number and return the computed backoff delay to callers.
Adds an opt-in trusted_workspace_write policy in packages/codex/rust/environment.rs and a sandbox patch adding with_local_macos_deny_paths.
Single-token removal of await on the axios.get() HMR check in src/core/webview/ClineProvider.ts.
New packages/ai/src/protocols/xai-images.ts adapter adds xAI image generation and is registered from providers/xai.ts.
packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/tui.ts adds a win32 branch that appends .exe to the go build output and skips chmod.
aisdk-native.ts adds a forwarded overlay merged after translated.body, with v1 config migration adjusted in packages/core/src/v1/config/migrate.ts.
vertexBaseUrl is added to provider-settings and selected as baseURL in anthropic-vertex.ts/gemini.ts, with a checkbox in Vertex.tsx.
src/services/mcp/McpHub.ts is reworked (+201/-216) and the MCP SDK plus reconnecting-eventsource dependencies are bumped for a Streamable HTTP transport.
packages/ai/src/protocols/gemini.ts adds endOnUserTurn() to drop a thought-only model tail or append a 'Continue.' user turn.
agents.py __call__ computes is_max_steps_error/is_empty_result and passes them into the managed_agent prompt template variables.
New src/manifests/ validation modules and manifest-setup-dialog.tsx add a UI manifest host, essentially all new files.
94-file mechanical All-Hands-AI to OpenHands string replacement spanning README/docs, .github workflows, evaluation files and a few source strings.
contentGenerator.ts reorders createContentGenerator parameters and funnels all auth branches through one LoggingContentGenerator wrap of a baseGenerator.
docs/source/en/index.mdx fixes a missing parenthesis in one link (1 line changed).
extensions/cli/src/ui/IntroMessage.tsx gains an optional organizationName prop rendered above Agent, fed by a useOrganizationName hook in TUIChat.tsx.
aider/queries/tree-sitter-languages/julia-tags.scm is rewritten for the current tree-sitter-julia node names to stop repo-map query errors.
packages/core/src/workflows/{workflow,default,types}.ts widen WorkflowState step data (payload, startedAt, endedAt, error) across the workflow engine.
_msgpack.py replaces the import-time STRICT_MSGPACK_ENABLED constant with a strict_msgpack_enabled() accessor now called from jsonplus.py and the pregel/graph entry points.
